forecasted_exhaustion_days.description:
ForecastedExhaustionDays is the estimated days until the fastest-growing resource
hits 100% of its limit (vs 85% used by DaysUntil85Percent).
-1 means usage is stable or no limit is set.

recommended_replica_increase.description:
RecommendedReplicaIncrease is the suggested number of additional replicas to add
to keep the resource below 70% utilisation after scaling.
0 means no scaling action recommended.

instances.description:
Instances is a list of input instances for prediction
Each instance is a list of feature values

model.description: Model is the name of the model to call (e.g., "anomaly-detector")

model_name.description: ModelName is the name of the model that made the prediction

model_version.description: ModelVersion is the version of the model

predictions.description: Predictions contains the model predictions (for anomaly-detector: []int)

model.description: Model is the name of the model

namespace.description: Namespace is where the model is deployed

service.description: Service is the KServe InferenceService name

status.description: Status is the health status (ready, unavailable, unknown)

confidence.description:
Confidence is a score between 0.0 and 1.0 indicating detection confidence
Higher values indicate more certainty in the detection

detected_at.description: DetectedAt is the timestamp when detection occurred

method.description: Method is the detected deployment method

resource_kind.description: ResourceKind is the kind of resource (Pod, Deployment, etc.)

resource_name.description: ResourceName is the name of the resource (pod, deployment, etc.)

source.description: Source is the metadata source used for detection (e.g., "annotation", "label")

timeout.description: Max time to wait for health

wait_time.description: Time to wait after this step

throttle_rate_pct.description:
ThrottleRatePct is the CPU throttle rate (%) over the analysis window.
Nil when cAdvisor CFS metrics are not available.

critical_count.description: CriticalCount is the number of filesystems with urgency == "critical".

warning_count.description: WarningCount is the number of filesystems with urgency == "warning".

available_bytes.description: AvailableBytes is the current free space in bytes.

daily_fill_rate_bytes.description: DailyFillRateBytes is the average bytes consumed per day (negative = shrinking).

days_until_full.description:
DaysUntilFull is days until the filesystem is 100% full.
-1 means usage is stable or shrinking.

mountpoint.description: Mountpoint is the filesystem mount path (e.g. "/", "/var/lib/containers").

node.description: Node is the Kubernetes node hosting this filesystem.

projected_full_date.description: ProjectedFullDate is the ISO-8601 date when the filesystem will be full (empty when stable).

total_bytes.description: TotalBytes is the total filesystem size in bytes.

used_percent.description: UsedPercent is the current usage as a fraction (0.0–1.0).

cpu_throttle_rate.description:
CPUThrottleRate is the ratio of throttled CPU time (0.0–1.0).
Source: container_cpu_cfs_throttled_seconds_total / container_cpu_cfs_periods_total
Nil when cAdvisor CFS metrics are not available in Prometheus.

http_degraded.description: HTTPDegraded is true when error rate > 5% or P99 latency > 1000ms.

http_error_rate.description:
HTTPErrorRate is the fraction of requests returning 5xx status codes.
Source: rate(container_http_requests_total{status=~"5.."}[5m]) / rate(container_http_requests_total[5m])
Nil when HTTP metrics are not available (requires Istio/OSSm or instrumented apps).

http_response_time_p99_ms.description:
HTTPResponseTimeP99Ms is the 99th-percentile HTTP response time in milliseconds.
Source: histogram_quantile(0.99, istio_request_duration_milliseconds_bucket)
Nil when Istio metrics are not available.

throttling_detected.description: ThrottlingDetected is true when CPUThrottleRate exceeds 25%.

confidence.description: Confidence is a 0.0–1.0 score indicating certainty of the leak classification.

daily_growth_bytes.description: DailyGrowthBytes is the average memory increase per day.

growth_r_squared.description: GrowthRSquared is the R² of the linear regression (higher = more confident trend).

leak_detected.description: LeakDetected is true when growth is monotonically increasing with high confidence.

scope.description: Optional: pod, deployment, namespace, cluster (default: namespace)
